prompt.project_info: Candid couple portrait on a rocky cove after swimming at golden hour.
prompt.main_subject: Two approved adults with wet hair and natural skin texture, seated at a rocky sea edge; one gently kisses the other's forehead while the other closes eyes briefly, woman in a simple swimsuit with loose light cotton shirt and man in plain partly wet cotton T-shirt with simple swim shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 medium close handheld frame, couple in foreground, panoramic sea, sun path, pine hills, rocks, tiny distant fishing boat and a simple wrinkled towel visible.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Golden-hour rim light on wet hair, soft sky fill, controlled highlights and detailed shadows, quiet sincere romantic documentary mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 35mm equivalent candid photography, subtle film grain, realistic wet skin and salt-water sheen, imperfect friend-shot framing, no HDR or AI glow.
